_comment: Cost-optimization behavior config for Greptile (PR #946). Sits alongside the v1 .greptile/config.yaml that governs knowledge-base indexing (focus_paths, semantic_tags, etc.). This file owns the v3 review-behavior fields: trigger cadence, review tier, comment shape, file-pattern exclusions at review time, and label gates. See AGENTS.md and 'Greptile Code Review' for the cost rationale. Source schema: https://www.greptile.com/docs/code-review/greptile-config-reference
_autoReview_note: Restrict reviews to PR open / ready_for_review / reopened / trigger-label. Stops the re-review-on-push tax that previously burned credits on every 'fix typo' push.
_effort_note: Pin to Base (1 credit per review). The dashboard's previous default was Apex (10 credits) for the largest PRs — the single biggest driver of the ~$330/month (post-discount) bill. Auto tier picks 1/3/10 credits by size; base is the cheapest at the same review depth.
_commentTypes_note: Drop 'style'. Style-level commentary is the bulk of the noise that overlaps with ESLint (already wired into pnpm lint and the new lint-staged pre-commit hook); Greptile keeps the higher-value logic and syntax findings.
_ignorePatterns_note: Review-time file exclusion (.gitignore syntax). Distinct from .greptile/config.yaml's ignore_paths which controls INDEXING. Together they keep both the corpus and the per-review attention set off the lockfile and post-merge-doc subgraphs.
_disabledLabels_note: Opt-out labels. Apply either label to a PR that touches no-semantic-diff and should not burn credits (e.g. CI-only infra, secret rotation, etc.).
